# libbpf / bpf-object-fuzzer

libbpf's own fuzz target `bpf-object-fuzzer` ([source](source/bpf-object-fuzzer.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libbpf (libbpf/libbpf at f7081a6b).

bpf_object__open_mem on the input as an in-memory ELF BPF object (log printing silenced); on success the object is closed. The open error code only selects an early return; nothing is inspected.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libbpf at commit f7081a6b.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libbpf` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `bpf-object-fuzzer.plain` | 298,536 | `2e3ab335d5125e4f7b71cbd9a3afd5a5b31e55c53c970345471819cc06246166` |
| ubsan | `bpf-object-fuzzer.ubsan` | 317,912 | `6d7af3dc36704ebb68ea4744182d1c356109583c5a233ff2b43d29dae609acc5` |
| asan | `bpf-object-fuzzer.asan` | 1,120,056 | `f732c7dbf094688475c5e886e74ab694567d070dfbe1877d564b1d8f36b26455` |
| asan-ubsan | `bpf-object-fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 1,138,904 | `b5e1abe44489600c8f98df4912bb68bb58d25c1280d2517eacaf8aaa22be9064` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libelf.a` (a library from the build image), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libelf.a` (a library from the build image), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libelf.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libelf.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
